title: Lamb Tagine with Smoky Flair
description: A traditional Portuguese-inspired tagine dish featuring tender lamb and rich smoky flavors.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, then set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the onion and smoked peppers until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and honey. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (optional).
